book.name: Lum
book.title: Ŋwa' wvù Baul to saŋɛɛ ɛ̂ kentaashɛ ke Lum

content: Wee egeè fiɛɛ fi ejeè tɛn waa bwee le
Beene bò tɛmyi kɛŋke keekuulè shém bô gbwee dì bonyii bo wɛɛyi gbwee. Fo beene egeè fiɛɛ ɛ ɛ̀ nu kɛ fì ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ ye ejee kɛ ɛ ɛ̀ nu beene kɛ.
Wee mwaaŋ mwaaŋ beene le kɛŋke keemomte keegeè fiɛɛ fì ejeè waa bwee le keefici wvú ɛ mbee we kuu.
Ben keè tɛn lɛ kɛ Jisos Klistu to gee mwɛɛm mvù ye ejeè kɛ ɛ ɛ̀ nu wvú kɛ. Wvú to gee fiew ɛ fí kooyi no bó saŋ ɛ wee jemyi ɛ̂ Nyo' lɛ,

content.text: “Boncun bò bonyii nan'yi wo dvú nu ɛ tu yî yɛm e.”

content: Beene kee lo lɛ mwɛɛm mvunciim mvù bó to saŋɛɛ ɛ̂ Ŋwa' Nyo' le fwele to nu keetefe beene dvú, wvu lɛ mvú ege ɛ́ beene eleemè tɛmyi, ɛ́ mvuntelem mvusɛɛbeene eyvuwsè yî fiɛɛ fì beene taale fwe yî dvú le.
Me nlɛke lɛ Nyo' wvù gee ɛ bonyii leeme tɛmyi bvuu gee ɛ mvuntelem mvu bonyii le yvuwse, ege ɛ́ ben eceè yî fiɛɛ le fimwaaŋ ben ɛ bonyii bocii bii no Klistu Jisos duŋci,
wvu lɛ yî kentaashɛ le, ɛ́ ben ebenseè Nyo' wvù nu Icee Tata wesebeene wvù Jisos Klistu yî diɛw e miaaŋ.
Ben efiisɛn wee tfuu lɛŋlɛŋ no Klistu nu ɛ fiisɛn ben
Ben emum efiisɛn wee tfuu kɛ lɛŋlɛŋ no Klistu nu ɛ fiisɛn ben, ɛ́ mbense egɛnè ɛ̂ Nyo'.
Ɛ́ me ensee ɛ̂ ben lɛ Klistu to nu ɛ jo ɛkolɛ kew diɛwɛ waa lemme le fô Bojuu le keeduŋcɛ ɛ̂ bó lɛ Nyo' ké no jemyi kecɛɛy. Wvú to ge nonɛn keetom ŋkawma wvù Nyo' to nyaɛ ɛ̂ bo'icee cee bó.
Ɛ wvú to bvuu ge nonɛn wvu lɛ bonyii bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu nɛlo ebenseè tɛn Nyo' nje shen yì Nyo' kɛŋke fô bó le. Fifin nu no bó saŋɛɛ lɛ,

content.text: “No fí nu nonɛn, me nu ŋke embensee wo
ɛnte jo bonyii bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu.
Ɛ me nu ŋke en'yemte mbensee diee diuw.”

content: Ɛ fí bvuu nu ɛ bó ɛ saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Ben bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu, ben elaŋlaŋè ben ɛ bonyii bo Nyo' le.”

content: Ɛ fí bvuu nu tɛn ɛ bó ɛ saŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Bonyii bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu, ben ebenseè Tata.

content: Ɛ Yɛsaya to bvuu jeme tɛn lɛ,

content.text: “Biay mi nu ke esan ɛ̂ kfuu di Jɛɛse le.
Ɛ ɛ̀ nu wee wvù nu ke ebuy esaake bitum
bi bonyii bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu le.
Ɛ̀ nu yî ye le wvù bitum nu ke egɛɛ bvufee bvubole.”

content: Me nlɛke lɛ Nyo' wvù beene taale fwe yî ye le, eyiŋsɛn mvuntelem mvunɛn bô njoŋ noo nyɛkeey no ben nu ɛ lese fitele yî ye le, wvu lɛ ɛ̂ mvuŋgay mvu Keyoy ke Yuule le, ɛ́ ben etaale kɛ ɛ ɛ̀ nu fwe sekecii yî fiɛɛ fì ben kee lɛ ben nu ke ekɛŋkɛ le.
Shiee wvù Baul to saŋɛɛ ɛ̂ je yì wvú to saŋɛɛ le
Boom bo bwɛɛm e, me kebɛɛ ŋkee ntay lɛ ben kɛŋke naa keŋge kè jee baay, ɛ ben ɛ yiŋsɛn bô bvufee, kee tɛn keetefe bikuu binɛn.
Geenɛn, yî mwɛɛm mvumew e nu ɛ me ɛ nsaŋ ɛ nloocɛ ɛ ntooshɛ lo ben. Ɛ me ŋge nonɛn keeŋkume lo ben, ɛ ɛ̀ nu nje mbuwma wvù Nyo' nu ɛ buw me dvú,

lɛ me enù wee lemme Klistu Jisos fô bonyii bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu le. Me ŋgee lemme din diɛwɛ cee ncese le, nlemte yî saaka wvù jee wvù wvu Nyo' le, wvu lɛ bonyii bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu enù diɛwɛ ncese wvù Nyo' nu ɛ bee le, ɛ Keyoy ke Yuule ɛ seyse bó ɛ gɛɛ bó ɛ no yuule.
Nje Klistu Jisos, nu ɛ ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ me embensee ye yî lemme dì me nlemte fô Nyo' le.

Kɛ ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ me emom lo enjeme ɛkumɛ fiɛɛ fimew jɛɛy, ɛfey fì Klistu nu ɛ ge wase fele yî yɛm e, lɛ bonyii bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu elese fitele yî ye le kɛ. Bó to lese fitele bii mwɛɛm mvù me nto njemyi bô mvù me nto ŋgee le.

Ɛ ɛ̀ to nu tɛn bii mvuŋgay mvu mwɛɛm mvù duŋci mvuŋgay mvu Nyo' le bô mwɛɛm mvu diuw wvù yumɛɛn e mvù me nto ŋgee le, noo yî mvuŋgay mvu Keyoy ke Yuule le. Nonɛn, keekɛw Jɛlusalɛm ekɛnɛn egɛn ebuy keba kè Illilikum e, nu ɛ me ɛ nloocɛ wase ɛ nfewcɛ saaka wvù jee ɛkumɛ Klistu jó.
Me nto gee nonɛn, ɛ shiee wɛm wvu baay nu lɛ me enfewcì saaka wvù jee wvun ɛ ɛ̀ nu fô bó ke baa yuw wase ɛkumɛ Klistu kɛ, wvu lɛ fo me ŋke enɛ eŋgɛn en'yoote yî kenffuy ke wee mvu le kɛ.
Me nto ŋgee fifin mbii ɛ ɛ̀ nu no bó to saŋɛɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bonyii bò bó ke baa see wase ɛ̂ bó ɛkumɛ wvú,
nu ke eyɛn kecɛɛy kew e,
ɛ bonyii bò ke baa yuw wase ɛkumɛ wvú, nu ke ekiɛɛ wvú.”

content: No Baul to seysee keegɛn Lum
Ɛ̀ se jewse lɛne din me bokaŋ e nteen fo me ento ɛ́ beene eyɛnɛn.
Geenɛn, keseen kɛ bvudvuu bvu lemme le bvuu bɛɛ dvú biba bin e kɛ. Nonɛn no me nse nshee nshieele wase bilum e keento ɛ́ beene eyɛnɛn,

nu ɛ me ŋkpwaake, ŋkee naa lɛ beene nu ke eyɛnɛn seke me nfele ŋgɛne Sbɛɛn. Me ŋkpwaake tɛn lɛ ben nu ke eficɛ me yî lɛne diem e keeŋgɛn embuy jó, seke beene ɛ moocɛ caan, me ɛ n'yuw njoŋ ɛ̂ ben ɛntelɛŋ.
Geenɛn, keseen nu ɛ me nu eŋgɛn Jɛlusalɛm yî lemme le fô bonyii bò ɛ̀ nu bo Nyo' le bo jó le.
Me ŋgɛne jó njefo bonyii bo mbee le bo Masedonia noo bo Akɛya se nu ɛ no kooŋke keege kensuw efi bonyii bò ɛ̀ nu bo Nyo' le bò fuute dvú Jɛlusalɛm.

Ɛ̀ to koŋ bó keege nonɛn, ɛ ɛ̀ nu lo kecɛɛy lɛ bó kɛŋke keege fiɛɛ fô bó le nonɛn, njefo ɛ́ bó bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu nu ɛ kɛŋkɛ wase fô mbuwma wvù fici biyoy bibole wvù ɛ̀ nu wvu Bojuu, tu bó kɛŋke tɛn keefi Bojuu bô mwɛɛm mvu yî nshɛ le fɛn mvù Nyo' nu ɛ buw bó dvú.
Nonɛn, seke me ɛ mɛse lemme din, ɛ n'yɛn lɛ fiɛɛ fì bó suw nu ɛ ley can Bojuu le, ɛ́ me emum enɛ jó, enfey jo ben, ɛ́ beene eyɛnɛn, ɛ́ me emum eŋgɛn Sbɛɛn.
Ɛ me ŋkee lo lɛ me nu ŋke endioo entoo ɛ̂ ben e, entoo bô kembonɛn ke Klistu le fô ben e ɛ kí ɛ yiŋsɛn.
Boom bo bwɛɛm e, me ŋkule lo can ɛ̂ ben ɛ̂ diee di Tata wesebeene wvù Jisos Klistu le noo yî keŋkoŋɛn ke Keyoy ke Yuule le, lɛ ben ebɛne me le ɛ́ beene etaashɛ ebunlee shiee le ɛ̂ Nyo' fô me le,
lɛ ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ me ŋke embuy can bonyii bò yaa nu kɛ bo mbee le Judea. Beene ebunleè tɛn lɛ bonyii bò ɛ̀ nu bo Nyo' le ke ebee lemme dì me ŋgɛne keeŋge Jɛlusalɛm e,
wvu lɛ ɛ́ Nyo' fɛn nu ɛ bee, ɛ́ me ŋke entoo ɛ̂ ben e n'yuuke njoŋ, ɛ́ fitele fiem elɛɛtene ɛ̂ ben ɛntelɛŋ.
Nyo' wvù nu Nyo' nyɛkeey enù ben ɛ bó bocii. Fí enù nonɛn.
